primary_endpoint.name: security_state_new_total
primary_endpoint.description: Number of testcases that triggered new security_state coverage transitions during the fuzzing run
primary_endpoint.justification: This metric directly reflects the fuzzer's ability to discover new security-relevant program states, which is the primary scientific question.

effectiveness_related.name: security_state_total
effectiveness_related.description: Total security_state coverage observed (cumulative, not new)
effectiveness_related.justification: Provides context about absolute coverage levels, but confounds initial corpus with new discoveries.

validity_contract.name: body_score_rpc_ok
validity_contract.description: Number of successful RPC calls to the scoring backend
validity_contract.justification: Required >0 for run validity; not a scientific endpoint.

validity_contract.name: body_score_rpc_fail
validity_contract.description: Number of failed RPC calls to the scoring backend
validity_contract.justification: Required =0 for run validity; not a scientific endpoint.

validity_contract.name: trace_invocations
validity_contract.description: Number of times the scorer trace mechanism was invoked
validity_contract.justification: Required >0 for run validity; not a scientific endpoint.

validity_contract.name: body_score_pass
validity_contract.description: Number of testcases that passed the scoring threshold
validity_contract.justification: Describes model-specific filtering behavior; useful for understanding accept/reject patterns but not a primary effectiveness measure.

validity_contract.name: body_score_reject
validity_contract.description: Number of testcases that failed the scoring threshold
validity_contract.justification: Describes model-specific filtering behavior; useful for understanding accept/reject patterns but not a primary effectiveness measure.

runtime_diagnostics.name: counted_execution_count
runtime_diagnostics.description: Total executions counted by the fuzzer during the run
runtime_diagnostics.justification: Engineering diagnostic; helps verify execution budget was actually consumed.

runtime_diagnostics.name: wall_clock_seconds
runtime_diagnostics.description: Wall-clock time elapsed during the fuzzing run
runtime_diagnostics.justification: Engineering diagnostic; helps verify time budget was respected.

runtime_diagnostics.name: target_baseline_identity
runtime_diagnostics.description: Hash or identifier of the target baseline state used
runtime_diagnostics.justification: Required for reproducibility; not a scientific endpoint.

notes: Validity gates must pass before a run contributes to the analysis denominator.
A valid run with security_state_new_total = 0 is a scientific zero result, not an exclusion.
Diagnostic counters do not replace the primary endpoint in the analysis.
Secondary endpoints are reported descriptively unless explicitly promoted to confirmatory status before execution.
